seo.title: Projects
seo.description: Things Navin Bhattarai has designed and built: a 3D-printed temple, Design/Build/Fly aircraft structures, a cold-plate test rig, CookNup, CAD projects and a Raspberry Pi humidifier.

header.title: Hand me a power tool and I'll figure it out.
header.summary: Making is my hobby; thermal-fluids is my intellectual home. Here's what I've designed, built, broken and rebuilt.

featured.title: A home temple, 3D-printed in pieces
featured.text: My proudest build. The printer was too small, so I split the design into pieces joined with alignment pins and tab-and-slot joints. It took tens of failed prints.
featured.alt: A white 3D-printed home temple with lattice panels, a tiered finial and murtis inside

items.title: Design/Build/Fly: structures co-lead
body: I co-lead the structures sub-team of WashU's Design/Build/Fly team. I design aircraft structural components and subassemblies in SOLIDWORKS for manufacturability, working with the aerodynamics and propulsion teams.
I also designed and fabricated a motor test stand for full-throttle thrust and power testing, using stress analysis to balance rigidity, portability and safety.

images.alt: Navin on an airfield holding a red and black team aircraft

items.title: Senior design: a cold-plate test rig
body: My team of three is building an instrumented liquid cold-plate test rig, based on the ASME K-16/ITherm cold plate competition geometry: a 78×78 mm copper baseplate under a 10-die, GPU-style heat map at 448 W, with 2.25 L/min of water at a 45 °C inlet.
It will measure thermal resistance and pressure drop, and compare a 3D-printed optimized fin insert against a straight-fin baseline. It's being built now, so there are no results yet.

items.title: CookNup
body: A cooking helper my team built at a hackathon. Take a photo of what's in your fridge: CookNup uses an API to recognize the ingredients, suggests recipes you can make, and builds a grocery list of what to buy.

images.alt: CookNup's home screen with a sign-in card in front of a photo of an open fridge
CookNup showing a suggested recipe with its ingredient list

items.title: SnackUp snack container
body: A modular, two-compartment snack cup with a cylindrical base that fits a car cup holder, plus a handle. I designed it in SOLIDWORKS for injection molding, with draft angles and constant wall thickness, and checked the snap-fit clip geometry with a tolerance stack-up analysis and 3D-printed prototypes.

images.alt: A blue 3D-printed snack cup with a black handle and a red inner tray
Top view of the snack cup showing two compartments

items.title: Mechanical pencil assembly
body: A 10-part SOLIDWORKS assembly with a spring-loaded lead-advance mechanism, with exploded views, cross-sections and a bill of materials.

images.alt: Engineering drawing of a mechanical pencil with a section view, numbered parts and a bill of materials

items.title: Automated humidifier controller
body: A Raspberry Pi with sensors and Python code that switches a humidifier on and off on its own.

images.alt: A Raspberry Pi wired to a breadboard, a relay module and a sensor
